_doc: Edit permissions for this page. ONE setting: edit_mode. 'propose-only' = the user can ask for changes, nothing they ask changes anything; each ask (and each answer set from the questions) goes to a private queue for Danny's yes (chat.py propose / proposals). 'allow-listed' = only items in allowed_without_danny may be done without Danny. Unknown values fall back to propose-only. Changing this needs Danny's yes.
